acceptance: Conflict handling (newest `now` wins, with confirmation in the UI)

v0.2 – Backend.title: Server-side validation of saves and offline progress (anti-cheat)
v0.2 – Backend.body: Reuse the pure simulation from `packages/shared` on the server to check that uploaded saves are plausible (max production × elapsed time, offline cap 8 h, cost curves).
acceptance: Server rejects saves with impossible currency gains
Shared tests cover the validation function
Document tolerance rules in an ADR

acceptance: GET /quests/daily returns the same set for everyone

v0.2 – Backend.body: GitHub Actions: build images, push to GHCR, deploy via SSH with `docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml pull && up -d`. Nightly `pg_dump` with retention.

v0.2 – Backend.title: release-please PRs need a token that triggers CI
v0.2 – Backend.body: PRs opened with `GITHUB_TOKEN` do not trigger workflows, so release PRs never get the required status checks of the `main` ruleset. Use a GitHub App token (e.g. actions/create-github-app-token) or a fine-grained PAT for release-please.
acceptance: Release PR shows green required checks
Merging it creates tag + GitHub release
